meta.title: Oh-My-BBFF Memory
meta.description: Oh-My-BBFF memory for DSH: full-resident or routed Markdown injection, memory_* tools, session toggles, and the in-process Dreaming Resident.

ui.settings.helpLabel: Show effect of changing this setting
ui.settings.missingEffectNotice: Some settings lack effect text; existing descriptions or no text are used.
ui.settings.invalidGroupsNotice: Basic grouping data is incomplete; the legacy flat view is retained.
ui.setting.defaultMode.effect: Sessions without their own mode follow this choice; full memory uses more context than on-demand recall.
ui.setting.injectEnabled.effect: Stop adding new memory automatically; already retained conversation content is not erased.
ui.setting.budgetMode.effect: Use a token share of the model window, or switch to an explicit fixed byte cap.
ui.setting.budgetWindowRatio.effect: Higher values reserve more context for memory; lower values omit or shorten memory sooner.
ui.setting.budgetFixedBytes.effect: Applies only in fixed mode; smaller values cut memory sooner, larger values consume more context.
ui.setting.workspaceMemoryDirs.effect: Legacy directories stay read-only; .dsh/memory wins by filename and receives every workspace change.
ui.setting.routeWindowTurns.effect: Consider more recent user messages, with a greater chance that older topics influence recall.
ui.setting.routeTopK.effect: Allow more relevant files per step, using more context.
ui.setting.routeMaxBytes.effect: Allow longer recalled text, still bounded by the overall injection cap.
ui.setting.dreamEnabled.effect: Stop starting new memory reviews while keeping existing memory usable.
ui.setting.dreamAutoWake.effect: Review on schedule when enabled; otherwise review only after an explicit wake.
ui.setting.wakeIntervalHours.effect: Shorter intervals review memory more often and may increase model calls and cost.
ui.setting.retryAfterFailure.effect: Retry undelivered wakes, without replaying a failed memory commit.
ui.setting.retryDelayMs.effect: Retry failed delivery sooner, with more closely spaced attempts.
ui.setting.retryMaxAttempts.effect: Permit more extra attempts for a scheduled wake, with a longer failure-recovery period.
ui.setting.includeSubagentSessions.effect: Include genuine user messages from subagents, potentially increasing review volume.
ui.setting.deltaMaxSessions.effect: Check more sessions in one pass; unprocessed records remain for later passes.
ui.setting.deltaMaxMessagesPerSession.effec: Process more messages from one session per pass; remaining content is continued later.
ui.setting.deltaMaxBytesPerSession.effect: Read more text from each session in a pass, increasing the amount read at once.
ui.setting.deltaMaxBytesTotal.effect: Process more pending text per pass; the unprocessed remainder is not discarded.
ui.setting.deltaManifestPageSize.effect: List more pending sessions per page without changing the total pending content.
ui.setting.dreamPageBytes.effect: Read more review text per page, producing longer responses.
ui.setting.dreamWakeSessionLimit.effect: List more sessions in the wake prompt; others remain accessible through paging.
ui.setting.dreamPromptMaxBytes.effect: Allow a more complete wake prompt, consuming more context.
ui.setting.candidatePageSize.effect: Show more candidate proposals per page, making the page longer.
ui.setting.residentModelMode.effect: Fixed mode uses the three fields below; default mode follows the Resident session's own selected model and never drifts with the global default.
ui.setting.residentProvider.effect: Use this provider for fixed-mode Resident requests without changing ordinary session models.
ui.setting.residentModel.effect: Use this model for fixed-mode Resident requests, potentially changing capability, speed and cost.
ui.setting.residentReasoningEffort.effect: Set reasoning effort for fixed-mode Resident requests; leave empty to follow the model default.
ui.setting.schedulerTickMs.effect: Notice due reviews sooner by checking state more frequently.
ui.setting.schedulerBootDelayMs.effect: Check for due reviews earlier after startup, concentrating more work at startup.
ui.setting.leaseHeartbeatMs.effect: Refresh ownership information sooner, with more frequent ownership-record writes.
ui.setting.leaseStaleMs.effect: Flag old ownership information sooner, without taking ownership solely because time elapsed.
ui.setting.apiPendingPollMs.effect: Show background-read progress sooner by polling the interface more often.
ui.setting.apiReadBackgroundTimeoutMs.effec: Warn sooner when background state reads take too long.
ui.setting.sessionReadReuseMs.effect: Reuse session reads longer; some newly derived state may appear later.
ui.setting.sessionReadMaxRoots.effect: Retain read state for more sessions, using more memory.
ui.setting.sessionReadCheckpointBytes.effec: Reuse more read information after reopening, at the cost of more disk space.
ui.setting.sessionReadMaxBytes.effect: Retain more session text in memory, increasing memory use.
ui.setting.memoryPollMs.effect: Refresh the memory cards more often, increasing state requests.
ui.setting.clockTickMs.effect: Make countdowns appear smoother with more frequent interface updates.
ui.setting.changelogPageSize.effect: Show more history records per page, making the page longer.
ui.setting.memorySourceMaxBytes.effect: Allow larger memory files to be read; oversized files are explicitly omitted.
ui.setting.candidateMaxBytes.effect: Allow longer candidate proposals; proposals above the limit are still rejected.
ui.setting.toolReadMaxBytes.effect: Allow memory tools to read more text at once, producing longer results.
ui.setting.toolWriteMaxBytes.effect: Allow longer memory writes while still refusing content above the limit.
ui.setting.httpBodyMaxBytes.effect: Save larger settings or prompt changes in one request, accepting larger request bodies.
ui.setting.errorHistoryLimit.effect: Retain more recent errors for a longer troubleshooting history.
ui.setting.errorMessageMaxChars.effect: Retain longer error explanations, making diagnostic entries longer.
ui.setting.stageReasonMaxChars.effect: Allow more detailed reasons for each memory change.
ui.setting.stageEvidenceMaxChars.effect: Attach more supporting evidence to each memory change.
ui.setting.stageMaxBytesTotal.effect: Commit larger file changes at once, requiring more backup space.
ui.setting.stageMaxOps.effect: Commit more file operations at once, widening the scope of each change.
